YOUR COLLECTION
Document library
Reviewed text saved on this device. Images are never stored in the library.


MEASURE, DON'T GUESS
Evaluation lab
Compare a prediction against a verified transcript. Punctuation and digits count.
 
NFC grapheme CER uses Unicode grapheme segmentation. WER splits on whitespace. These are text-pair metrics, not a model benchmark. The Python toolkit supports corpus evaluation.


PROVENANCE FIRST
Dataset registry
Source discovery is separate from downloaded, verified training data.
Verified word training pool7,997 · 1,000 selected
Verified word validation pool8,003 · 500 selected
Verified word test pool8,000 · 500 selected
The bounded audit verified 24,000 word samples and 3,491 labeled pages. The word pilot uses frozen 1,000 / 500 / 500 subsets. Page training awaits clarification of dataset terms. Writer identities and source labels still need human verification.


OPEN WORKFLOWS
Built to work with your stack.
A small REST API, structured exports and reproducible Python tools.
Connect your model
Run the included API locally. Model loading requires an authorized IndicOCR checkpoint and its official dependencies. The UI works without a model for manual review.
python -m uvicorn ocr.server:app \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
Use the local website for a loopback API. Hosted HTTPS pages may block local HTTP connections.
Predict a page
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/predict \
  -F "file=@page.png"
The response includes raw Markdown, ordered blocks, model identity and a mandatory review flag. Layout confidence is never presented as transcription confidence.
Download API contract ↓
Reproducible toolkit
python -m ocr.cli audit --root data --output manifests/all.jsonl --source my-corpus --license-ref CC-BY-4.0
python -m ocr.cli split --manifest manifests/all.jsonl --output manifests
python -m ocr.cli evaluate --input predictions.jsonl --output reports/metrics.json
Includes image verification, NFC labels, SHA-256, visual duplicate grouping, deterministic group splits and grapheme-level evaluation. The original recognizer passed forward, backward, adapter update, tiny-subset learning and save/reload checks. See Training & results for the pilot status and measured metrics.

MODEL CONNECTION
Your OCR, your infrastructure.
Connect the included API to transcribe uploads. No API keys are stored in the browser.
Not connected
From paper to possibility.
  1. Upload one or more images. Switch between them in the queue.
  2. Connect an authorized IndicOCR server, or import existing OCR JSON.
  3. Review the editable transcription against the original. Raw output stays unchanged.
  4. Verify, save on this device, and export as UTF-8 text, Markdown or JSON.
The built-in sample is a typeset illustration. The connected Telugu word pilot was tested on 500 held-out words; whole-page accuracy has not been measured.
